g.text: Firebase Auth, Firestore Task Creation, and Priority Feed
FIREBASE_MODE selects one backend for the whole process:
emulator mode uses loopback Auth/Firestore; cloud mode requires
a dedicated development project and server service-account credentials.
Firestore Rules deny browser reads/writes. Server repositories use
Admin SDK and enforce ownership themselves.
Sign up and establish application session
verify ID token and profile input
Add a task and reload the priority feed
Enter task and optionally choose a course
Allowlist/validate task fields and normalize dates
Calculate score; omit absent optional fields;
Show new task with score and course label
